result.description: Compact polyphonic desktop synthesizer designed for experimental sound design and live performance. Includes 8-note polyphony, dual wavetable engines, 37 velocity-sensitive mini keys, USB-MIDI, stereo line outputs, and onboard sequencer with 64 patterns. Powered by an external adapter and built for studio desks rather than computer expansion slots or storage use.
